serviceDescription.description: A description of the static basemap tiles service.

mapName.description: The name of the basemap style.

description.example: This layer provides a detailed basemap for the world symbolized with a classic Esri street map style.

copyrightText.example: Sources: Esri, TomTom, Garmin, FAO, NOAA, USGS, © OpenStreetMap contributors, and the GIS User Community

supportsDynamicLayers.description: Whether the service supports dynamic layers.

spatialReference.description: The spatial reference of the map.

singleFusedMapCache.description: Whether the service has a single fused map cache.

tileInfo.description: The tile information of the service.

initialExtent.description: The initial extent of the service.

fullExtent.description: The full extent of the service.

minScale.description: A number representing the minimum scale at which the layer will be visible. The number is the scale's denominator.

maxScale.description: A number representing the maximum scale at which the layer will be visible. The number is the scale's denominator.

supportedImageFormatTypes.description: The image format types supported by the service when generating a map image.

exportTilesAllowed.description: Whether exporting tiles in compact format (.tpk) is supported.

maxRecordCount.description: The maximum number of records that will be returned at once for a query.

maxImageHeight.description: The maximum image height in pixels.

maxImageWidth.description: The maximum image width in pixels.
